description: From the Roques de García viewpoint the great cone of Mount Teide stands centered against a deep starfield, with the Milky Way faintly crossing the upper frame. Dark volcanic plains stretch to the jagged rock spires in the foreground, and thin drifting clouds — consistent with the model weather's 63% cloud cover — soften a few stars. It is the quiet, unlit caldera of Teide National Park at night, rendered as a restrained long-exposure interpretation.
